name: Weathered Nook
summary: High above Thousand Needles, Dorn Plainstalker and Prate Cloudseer make their home in a quiet cliffside shelter. From there, they look out across the stone spires, far from the canyon floor.

sections.title: Haven on the Cliffs
sections.body: North of Freewind Post, a narrow ramp climbs the sandstone cliff to a sheltered ledge and cave. From below, travelers can easily miss the Weathered Nook high above the canyon basin. Dorn Plainstalker and Prate Cloudseer live here, away from any large settlement or military post. The ledge shelters them from the prevailing winds and gives them a broad view across the needle plateaus.

faq.q: Where is the Weathered Nook located?
faq.answer: The Weathered Nook lies along Thousand Needles' northern cliff wall. From Freewind Post, travel north to the towering rock face, then follow the cliffs east to a winding ramp up the mesa wall.

faq.q: Who lives in the Weathered Nook?
faq.answer: Dorn Plainstalker and Prate Cloudseer live in the Weathered Nook. The two solitary tauren dwell on this remote ledge above the canyon, rather than atop Freewind Post's crowded towers.

faq.q: Is the Weathered Nook affiliated with the Horde?
faq.answer: The Weathered Nook is a personal camp and wilderness home, not a formal Horde garrison. Its residents are tauren among their own kindred.

angles.text: As a tauren, you can find a quiet place for self-reliance at the Weathered Nook. The ledge offers a peaceful view across the canyon, away from Freewind Post's busy bridges.
As a Horde wanderer, you can find friendly kindred sheltering along the canyon's northern cliffs.
